title: Orbit — A planetary observatory
description: A contemplative, dark observatory with eight procedural 3D planets, subtle orbit traces, curated field notes, accessible planet selection, camera orbit and zoom, close observation, overhead and perspective views, playback, adjustable speed, and reset. Responsive layouts and a readable WebGL fallback are included.
